title: Convergence on a dense family plus uniform mass bounds gives convergence on all tests supported in O × G (step 7)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^N measurable, A := O × G(N,n), and g_m ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) (m ∈ ℕ) with tsupport g_m ⊆ A such that for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ A and every η > 0 there is m with |f − g_m| ≤ η everywhere. Let μ_k, ν_k (k ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^N × G(N,n) and C ∈ [0,∞) such that μ_k(A) ≤ C and ν_k(A) ≤ C for all sufficiently large k and ∫ g_m dμ_k − ∫ g_m dν_k → 0 for every m. Then ∫ f dμ_k − ∫ f dν_k → 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (μ ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet O → C ≠ ∞ → (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, μ k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ν k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, g m z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, g m z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, f z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
